_meta.warning: The legal_status fields have not been checked line by line against official sources and every one must be verified before launch. class decides the assistant behaviour branch, so a change here has to be mirrored in docs/prompts.md

classes.protected_native: Protected native species. The default branch. Must not be caught, relocated or harmed, and a damage mitigation permit is required
classes.dangerous: A risk to personal safety or public health. The assistant never draws a safety conclusion, never advises approaching or handling, and always refers to a licensed handler
classes.invasive: Invasive or unprotected species. The protection clauses do not apply, but the assistant still gives no method of killing and refers to the council official guidance
classes.unknown: Unidentified. Treated as dangerous until confirmed
